# MathJax 3.2.2 · locally bundled SVG output

- `tex-svg.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js
- `LICENSE`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/LICENSE

Unmodified upstream combined TeX-to-SVG renderer, acquired October 22, 2026. Apache 2.0; included upstream license. The SVG renderer uses local font definitions and requires no network font service. Lecture 15 does not request additional TeX extensions. Bundling keeps essential classroom equation rendering independent of a CDN. These third-party files retain their upstream license.
